> Category: **business** · Status:  · Version: 2.0.0

Apply evidence-backed practices for the candidate side of the hiring pipeline — resume writing, ATS/application strategy, interview preparation, salary negotiation, recruiter communication, and age-bias navigation. Materializes the career-advancement-practices knowledge bundle and provides phase-based workflows for resume improvement, interview preparation, and offer negotiation. Use when the user asks to write or improve a resume, prepare for an interview, negotiate a salary, communicate with a recruiter, optimize a LinkedIn profile, or navigate age bias in hiring. Do NOT trigger on general career advice without a specific hiring-pipeline component, internal promotion strategy, or cover letter writing.
